'''Kesipli''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] city of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kaikielius/Legends|Kaikielius]].

==History==
During the the [[Kaikieli Reconquista]], a conflict that was fought on Kaikielius, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Derrica Praji]] found some [[Data-tape/Legends|datatapes]] in Kesipli that showed that [[House Praji/Legends|House Praji]] had manipulated the [[Odominic]] kajidic into supplying both sides in the conflict.
